issues.failure_explanation: For general rank-k C, rvol(C)=1 only implies all singular values are equal to sigma_1(C), not that they equal 1. For example, C=2I has rvol=1 but non-orthonormal columns. The converse in the proof requires the missing unit-column-norm assumption.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Add the hypothesis that C has unit-norm columns (or that ||C||_2=1) to the lemma statement and proof.

issues.failure_explanation: The claimed inequality fails for p>2. For C=I_2 with C_1 and C_2 the two standard basis columns, C^dagger=I, so the left side is 2^{2/p}<2, while the right side is 1+1=2.
